description: This source file defines an Android activity named CreateBitmap which demonstrates bitmap creation, encoding, decoding, and drawing operations within an Android app. It includes a nested View class for rendering various bitmaps created programmatically.

classes.name: CreateBitmap
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up the UI and contains bitmap creation methods.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View class that creates, encodes, decodes, and draws various bitmaps on the Canvas.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method to initialize the activity and set the content view.

methods.name: createColors
methods.description: Generates an array of color integers to be used for bitmap pixel data.

methods.name: codec
methods.description: Encodes a Bitmap into a ByteArrayOutputStream using specified format and quality, then decodes it back into a Bitmap.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's onDraw to render multiple bitmaps and color arrays onto the Canvas.
